answer.justification: The patient likely has Clostridioides difficile infection, caused by gram-positive anaerobic rods and associated with recent antibiotics. C. difficile spores are resistant to alcohol and quaternary ammonium disinfectants; effective environmental decontamination to prevent transmission requires a sporicidal chlorine-based solution such as bleach.
